en.title: You can totally invent Transformers from memory.

en.title: Claude reveals the origins of the ECDSA curve
en.reason: Claude traced the ECDSA curve seeds for NIST P-192 through P-521 to the C library lrand48 seeded with Unix timestamps, cracking P-256 after 1842 iterations and closing a decades-old mystery with no backdoor found.
